description: Send a message to a three.ws-registered agent and receive its response. The target agent uses its configured brain (Claude model and system prompt set via its embed policy). Agents that have opted out of MCP delegation are refused. Useful for agent-to-agent collaboration and tool composition. Paid: $0.01 USDC.

model.description: Optional Claude model override (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6). Must be in the allowlist.
